source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of germ-killer cells (PDF 172-173).

blocks.text: Sab se ahem non-specific difa khoon ke germ-killer cells (jaraseem maarne wale cells) dete hain. Yeh microbes par hamla kar ke unhein maar dete hain. Yeh cells khoon mein gasht karte aur hamla awaron ka intezar karte rehte hain. In ki teen bunyadi qismein hain: macrophages, neutrophils aur natural killer cells.

Macrophages monocytes (white blood cells ki aik qism) se bante hain. Macrophage bacterium ko endocytosis (cell membrane se gher kar andar le lena) ke zariye nigal leta hai aur apne lysozyme enzymes se use maar deta hai. Kuch macrophages kuch aaza (organs), maslan lungs, liver (jigar), spleen (tilli) aur brain (dimagh), mein aik jagah tike rehte hain, lekin zyada tar khoon, lymph aur interstitial fluid (cells ke darmiyan ka maya) mein gasht karte hain.

blocks.alt: Bara gulabi macrophage jis ki satah jhurridar aur aik lamba ubhaar hai, aas paas dande jaise bacteria; aik bacterium us ke kinare se andar liya ja raha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.4: Jaraseem par hamla karta macrophage (kitab ki tasveer, Figure 21.4, ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Neutrophils bhi white blood cells ki aik qism hain. Yeh pathogens (bimari phelane wale jaraseem) ko maarne ke liye teen tareeqe istemal karte hain. Pehla tareeqa phagocytosis (nigal lena) hai. Doosre tareeqe mein yeh pathogens par ghulne wale (soluble) anti-microbial chemicals chhorte hain. Teesre tareeqe mein yeh DNA ke reshon (fibres) ka jaal bana kar bahar chhorte hain. Yeh reshe bimari wale bacteria se chipak kar unhein maar dete hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar aik neutrophil, teen teer us ke teen tareeqon tak: phagocytosis (pathogen cell ki jeb mein), anti-microbial kimiyai maadde chhorna (daane pathogen par), aur reshon (fibres) ka jaal jo pathogen ko phansata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.5: Pathogens maarne ke liye neutrophils ke tareeqe (kitab ki Figure 21.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Neutrophil, Pathogen, Anti-microbial chemicals, Fibres, Phagocytosis, Release of anti-microbial chemicals, Generation of network of fibres.

blocks.text: Natural killer (NK) cells lymphocytes ki aik qism hain jo non-specific difa ka hissa hain. Yeh hamla karne wale microbes ko khud nahin maarte, balke jism ke un cells ko pehchan kar un par hamla karte hain jin mein virus ka infection ho chuka ho. Yeh perforins naam ke khaas proteins chhorte hain jo target cell ki membrane mein ghus jate hain. Is se target cell ki membrane mein soorakh (pore) ban jata hai. Is soorakh se paani tezi se target cell mein ghusta hai, cell phool jata hai aur phat jata hai. NK cells cancer cells ko bhi pehchan lete hain aur unhein tumour (rasoli) banne se pehle hi maar dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab NK cells ko T-lymphocytes ki aik qism aur cytotoxic T-cells kehti hai. Yeh sahi nahin: NK cells lymphocytes zaroor hain lekin T cells nahin; yeh non-specific difa ka hissa hain, jab ke cytotoxic T cells specific immune response ka hissa hain (topic 21.3.2). Dono infected cells ko perforins se milte julte tareeqe se maarte hain, is liye in ko aksar mila diya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Khoon ka germ-killer cell target cell se chipka hua. Perforins ka daana target ki taraf khulta hai, perforins tang faasla paar karte hain aur target cell ki membrane mein chhallon jaise pores banate hain. Neeche target cell ka nucleus.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.6: Infected cell par hamla karta natural killer cell (kitab ki Figure 21.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Perforins, Germ-Killer cell of blood, Target cell, Pore, Nucleus, Cell membrane of target cell (infected cells).

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Gasht karne wale cells (macrophages, neutrophils aur natural killer cells) apne hi jism par hamla nahin karte, kyun ke jism ke tamam normal cells ki satah par aik protein ka nishan (marker) hota hai jo unhein pehchanwata hai. Is protein ko self-protein kehte hain. Khoon ke germ-killer cells self-proteins wale cells par hamla nahin karte; yeh sirf un cells par hamla karte hain jin mein aise proteins na hon.

blocks.prompt: Natural killer cell virus wale cell ko kaise maarta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh perforins chhorta hai jo infected cell ki membrane mein soorakh bana dete hain; soorakh se paani andar ghusta hai, cell phool kar phat jata hai.

items: Macrophages (monocytes se bante hain) bacterium ko endocytosis se nigal kar lysozyme enzymes se maarte hain.
Neutrophils: phagocytosis, anti-microbial chemicals, DNA fibres ka jaal.
NK cells perforins se virus wale aur cancer cells mein soorakh kar ke unhein phaar dete hain.
Self-proteins ki wajah se yeh cells apne jism ke cells par hamla nahin karte.
